blocks.text: NEW DELHI, India — India’s Prime Minister Narendra Modi hailed Indian pilot Smit Machchhar as a “HERO” on Thursday after he was wounded by his co-pilot aboard a Dubai-Tel Aviv flight, sparking a fight for control of the aircraft. “Captain Smit Machchhar is a HERO,” Modi said in a statement posted on social media.
